about: The library jog, a stride nearer the game's pace, in 15 poses (a character sheet holds 16 frames, the standing pose last): the more poses, the shorter a pose is held while the body moves under it. The silhouette limit is 25%: side-on the long-legged elf's spread stride and cloak change the area by up to 22% (the forager 14%), with no limb lost (checked in the strips).
